reviewer: Project-agent reading of the original source, scenarios, shared history, question and two actual publisher outcomes. No model output was available.

classes.local: Both replies determine the stated local rule or listed mechanism when interpreted in the supplied excerpt.
classes.conditional: Only one direction or a qualified harder question follows, or another required fact is missing.
classes.conflict: A branch conflicts with an already supplied fact or known failed prerequisite.
classes.insufficient: The snippet does not express the proposed decision rule.

items.reason: The excerpt gives a permission on disagreement. It does not expressly prohibit sending new information on agreement.
The scenario names Germany. An affirmative last reply claims the same country is Montenegro or New Zealand.
Management assistance is one of three listed services for a qualifying small business. The other two needs were explicitly denied.
The discharge condition can exclude the applicant. A favorable discharge alone cannot establish the separate length-of-service requirement.
The earlier replies deny timely registration and continuing UK job search. Looking abroad does not repair either failed requirement.
The scenario claims an Australian degree while the supplied history denies one. The excerpt explicitly exempts that degree.
The excerpt specifies a pharmacy-type incompatibility warning. The supplied reply determines whether that stated trigger applies.
Taking the named paid time off bars leave. Its absence does not establish the other requirements for paternity pay and leave.
The time-based requirement is already false. The final reply settles the only other listed trigger for headlights.
The first two listed types of tribunal case were denied. The last reply settles membership in the third.
The prior reply already denied the union of student finance and an apprenticeship. A final affirmative reply contradicts that denial.
The passage says a new EIN is generally required and explicitly refers elsewhere to decide applicability for an individual business.
The exemption is qualified and applies to foreign students. Being 28 and an apprentice does not establish that scope.
Ownership excludes Housing Benefit. The excerpt does not establish entitlement for all nonowners.
The history denies a compound request including building improvements, while the affirmative branch endorses that need and the scenario describes such work.
The other two listed participant roles have been denied. The last reply establishes or excludes the remaining listed role of agricultural producer.
The excerpt identifies a possible increase for Marriage Allowance and a reduction for high income. It supplies no net comparison when both conditions apply.
The excerpt lists countries beneath a heading. It never states how a country determines which contributions replace National Insurance.
The supplied rule has a single waiting period. The reply settles whether the stated 12-month condition to rejoin has elapsed.
Residence in a member state is only one prerequisite. Receipt of a listed pension or benefit and the applicability of earlier sections are unresolved.
The source separates limits by plant stage and by where possession occurs. The combined follow-up does not resolve those conditions for the unspecified item.
The scenario calls the recently deceased person the speaker’s husband of 43 years. The negative branch denies marriage when he died.
The rule requires both starting study and receiving the specified income support. The final question tests the conjunction itself.
Commercial activity rules out a utility airport. Its absence does not prove that an airport belongs to that class.
